blocks.text: A table variable holds a small set of rows inside a batch. It can help you practise a query without creating a permanent table.
Use SQL Server 2019+ in a separate practice database with a SQL editor. T-SQL is different from the SQLite engine on this site, so these examples are for that separate tool.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A table variable is not a persistent app database. Its scope ends with the batch.
